title: The Dutch Solution for Safer Sidewalks - Continuous Sidewalks
summary: A short Not Just Bikes video on continuous sidewalks in the Netherlands, where the sidewalk runs unbroken across side streets so cars must visibly cross pedestrian space. It places them within Dutch sustainable safety and Vision Zero efforts.
why: HN users point to it as a vivid example of how simple, intentional street design makes a big difference for pedestrian safety.
